bulk_basis.S_i: sin(k_i L)/k_i, entire in z with hyperbolic continuation

zero_values.S_i_0: sinh(M_i L)/M_i (continuous value L at M_i=0)

declared_boundary_prescription.bulk_action: int d2theta H_i^c (partial_y+M_i) H_i + h.c., with real odd kink mass M_i epsilon(y)
declared_boundary_prescription.fundamental_description: self-adjoint interval boundary condition, not an unqualified orbifold delta distribution
declared_boundary_prescription.interior_mass: M_i is the signed constant value on 0<y<L
declared_boundary_prescription.invariant_statement: all formulas below are exact in b; a nonzero bare mu is sufficient only after proving B_R(mu) is finite and nonzero
declared_boundary_prescription.one_sided_matching: B_R(mu)=mu, so b=|lambda<Theta>|, only in the explicit one-sided interval convention
declared_boundary_prescription.regulator_warning: a symmetric orbifold delta, shifted-brane regulator, or finite-width profile can change B_R and finite-b KK phases
declared_boundary_prescription.source_boundary_condition: g(L)+b sigma_1 f(L)=0 after rephasing b>=0

exact_characteristics.root_rule: the nonnegative real zeros z=m_n^2, with multiplicity, are the full KK singular-value spectrum

5D superspace on an orbifold and local brane operators
the SO(10) interval L=pi R/2, parity spectra, and boundary-mass shifts of KK conditions

projected_4D_vs_full_KK.full_tower_statement: rank 4 does not prove a parametrically heavy spectrum; at very large b the unselected tower contains a parametrically light state
projected_4D_vs_full_KK.rank_statement: each nonzero b gives a rank-2 chiral mass block per PS multiplet pair; b_L,b_R nonzero give rank 4 in (LF,LA,RA,RF)

canonical_cross_domain_zeta_ratios.boundary_row_convention: divide each two-channel boundary determinant by 1+b^2
canonical_cross_domain_zeta_ratios.scheme_warning: absolute determinants and cross-domain constants can be shifted by local boundary counterterms; zeros and same-domain P(z;b) are invariant

same_domain_hadamard_products.convergence: genus-zero products converge because m_n^2 grows as n^2

scope.interval: 0<=y<=L with L=pi R/2; PS wall at y=0 and full-Spin(10) source wall at y=L
not_in_scope: a UV derivation of the thin-brane matching map B_R

finite_nonzero_b.proof: D_++(0) is nonzero for b!=0 and finite real M_i,L; D_-+(0) is nonzero for every finite b

massless_exceptions: b=0: Theta VEV/coupling vanishes, or the regulator map B_R(mu) vanishes
a multi-copy boundary matrix is rank deficient
a parity error makes a purported source field Dirichlet so the local operator is zero
b=infinity is a different self-adjoint endpoint: an unselected (-,+) mode becomes exactly massless
new boundary degrees of freedom in a resolved-brane UV completion can add independent zero modes
zero_mode_and_tachyon_theorems.multi_copy_rank_rule: for n_1+n_2 selected chiral zero modes coupled by a boundary matrix mu of rank r, finite nonzero boundary profiles leave n_1+n_2-2r chiral zero modes
zero_mode_and_tachyon_theorems.outside_theorem: non-hermitian boundary matching, wrong-sign boundary kinetic/scalar terms, or SUSY breaking require a new stability audit
zero_mode_and_tachyon_theorems.tachyon_result: none for real M_i, finite L, and hermitian b sigma_1
